_comment: Marks scenario-14 as Hyper-V rather than Vagrant/VirtualBox.
inspect_eval/sysrepair_bench/task.py looks for lab/automatedlab.json and, when
present, drives the VM through these PowerShell entry points instead of
shelling out to `vagrant up`.
NOTE ON THE NAME: this scenario is NOT built by AutomatedLab -- that module has
no FreeBSD support. The filename is the marker task.py keys off (and what
scripts/build_croissant_manifest.py::detect_lab_os reads), so it is kept for
consistency with hivestorm/scenario-13. `os` here is freebsd, which makes
detect_kind report freebsd-vm.
The SSH contract is deliberately IDENTICAL to the one Vagrant provided --
an account on host.docker.internal:2222 reachable with the pipeline's key --
so solvers.py, scorer.py and the task prompt need no changes. Only the
provisioning mechanism changed. The account is root rather than vagrant:
there is no unattended path on this image (no cloud-init, no serial console,
sshd disabled), so the key had to be injected through the video console via
Msvm_Keyboard, and root is the only account that exists. task.py takes the
login from this file rather than hardcoding it.
Root's shell is tcsh, so Bsd14Ops.ps1 wraps every remote command in `sh -c`;
bourne redirections otherwise fail with 'Ambiguous output redirect'.
The baseline checkpoint is taken AFTER seed.sh has planted the
misconfigurations and after seed.sh and roles.json have been erased from the
VM, so a restore returns the box to exactly the state a graded run starts
from. scorer.py re-uploads roles.json for the duration of verification only.
